title: Yemen Conflict Tracker Update — Sep 26, 2026
summary: Backfilled the major September escalation: a Sep 8 Houthi broadside wounded 73 across Abha, Khamis Mushait, Jazan and Najran and took the Jazan refinery offline for a third time; the Houthis then captured the port of Mocha (Sep 10) and seized Mayyun Island and the Hanish Islands (Sep 11), gaining a direct foothold over the Bab al-Mandeb Strait. Government forces advanced in western Taiz (Sep 13-14) amid nearly 86,000 newly displaced, renewed Houthi strikes wounded 13 in three Saudi cities (Sep 14-15), and a Sep 19 ballistic missile became the first ever aimed at Riyadh — intercepted at dawn. Marib clashes through Sep 21 left over 50 Houthi fighters reported killed. KPIs, casualties, econ, claims, political, assets, retaliation, strike-targets, map data and the timeline were all updated; tracker marked breaking.
